snippet.title: Smalland - First Official Gameplay Trailer E3 2021
snippet.description:
Smalland is a massive adventure, on a tiny scale. 
Wishlist on Steam https://bit.ly/3iGMPnR 
Wishlist on Epic Games Store https://www.epicgames.com/store/p/smalland 

Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small, surrounded by massive creatures & at the bottom of the food chain. 
Craft weapons & armour, build encampments & explore a strange new land. 

Key Features 
- A huge open, sandbox-world to explore from a tiny perspective 
- Build bases and shelters with a host of upgrades and customisations 
- Discover the lore behind SMALLAND through quests and the hidden NPCs scattered throughout the world 
- Dynamic weather and random events organically create hazardous situations or fortunate events 
- Player upgrades and customisation, craft powerful armour to earn and unlock new abilities 
- Creature factions: Work alongside creatures, gain their trust, earn allies and mounts 
Add Smalland to your Steam wishlist https://bit.ly/3iGMPnR 
Join the Smalland Discord community at https://discord.gg/smalland 

Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/playsmalland 
Follow Merge Games on Twitter at https://twitter.com/MergeGamesLtd 
Find Merge Games at https://www.mergegames.com
